**Every tissue box lid tab is now the same - 2 mm thick, at both ends - and the catches stick out further.** The web version has it too: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Download & run (Windows)
1. Download **Vaseinator.exe** below and run it. It is one file: nothing to unzip or install. SHA256SUMS.txt holds its checksum.
2. The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

No Python needed. To run from source on any OS, see the README. Or just use it in your browser: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Changed in 1.15.5
- **All the tabs are alike.** The hooks were made thicker than the latches on purpose (in 1.15.4, 3.2 mm against 2 mm; before that, 1.6 mm against 1 mm), so one end of the lid looked twice as thick as the other. Now every tab, at both ends, is 2 mm thick - twice the old thin ones - with the same bump and the same height. The hooks still go in first, tilted, and the latches by the pull tab click in.
- **The catches stick out further**, behind the ledge, by **Lid grip**: Gentle 0.75 mm, Snug 0.95 mm, Firm 1.15 mm (from 0.5, 0.7 and 0.9 mm). They may now come to within 0.05 mm of the wall above the ledge, rather than 0.3 mm, so a catch reaches nearly as far as the ledge is deep. Where a cover's wall comes in above the ledge - rounded hole edges, lumps - the catch stops just short of it.
- It fits the covers you've already printed: save the lid again.

Vaseinator is free. If it has made you something you like, you can [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rickapps).
